# The Archfit policy, converted by archfit init from the Archfit 3 files and reviewed.
# docs/architecture.md explains it. Change it with `archfit request`, never by hand.
version: 3
owners:
  - alexei-led
gate: required
layers:
  - core
  - cmd
modules:
  cmd:
    paths:
      - cmd/**
    public:
      - cmd
    volatility: low
    subdomain: supporting
    layer: cmd
    depends_on:
      - pkg_chaos
      - pkg_container
      - pkg_runtime
  pkg_chaos:
    paths:
      - pkg/chaos/**
    public:
      - pkg/chaos
      - pkg/chaos/cliflags
      - pkg/chaos/*/cmd
    volatility: high
    subdomain: core
    layer: core
    depends_on:
      - pkg_container
      - pkg_util
  pkg_container:
    paths:
      - pkg/container/**
    public:
      - pkg/container
    volatility: medium
    subdomain: core
    layer: core
  pkg_runtime:
    paths:
      - pkg/runtime/**
    public:
      - pkg/runtime/*
    volatility: high
    subdomain: core
    layer: core
    depends_on:
      - pkg_container
      - pkg_tc
  pkg_tc:
    paths:
      - pkg/tc/**
    public:
      - pkg/tc
    volatility: high
    subdomain: core
    layer: core
  pkg_util:
    paths:
      - pkg/util/**
    public:
      - pkg/util
    volatility: low
    subdomain: supporting
    layer: core
rules:
  - id: no-container-to-chaos
    deny:
      from: pkg_container
      to: pkg_chaos
    why: pkg/container is the domain model that chaos consumes. Importing chaos inverts the dependency and couples the model to every chaos action.
    instead: Move the shared type or value into pkg/container, and import it from pkg/chaos.
  - id: no-chaos-to-runtime
    deny:
      from: pkg_chaos
      to: pkg_runtime
    why: Chaos says what to do through the container.Client interface; runtime adapters say how. A direct import bypasses the interface and ties chaos actions to one runtime.
    instead: Add the method to a container.Client sub-interface in pkg/container/client.go, and implement it in the runtime adapters.
  - id: no-util-to-domain
    deny:
      from: pkg_util
      to: pkg_chaos
    why: pkg/util must stay domain-agnostic so any package can use it without pulling in chaos behavior.
    instead: Keep code that needs chaos types in pkg/chaos; give pkg/util functions plain values.
exceptions:
  - rule: duplication
    from: cmd
    to: pkg_chaos
    why: The error existed when archfit init wrote this policy.
  - rule: duplication
    from: cmd
    to: pkg_runtime
    why: The error existed when archfit init wrote this policy.
  - rule: duplication
    from: pkg_chaos
    to: pkg_runtime
    why: The error existed when archfit init wrote this policy.
  - rule: duplication
    from: pkg_container
    to: pkg_runtime
    why: The error existed when archfit init wrote this policy.
tests:
  - '**/*_test.go'
  - '**/tests/**'
generated:
  - mocks/*.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Client.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Executor.go
  - pkg/container/mock_FilterFunc.go
  - pkg/container/mock_IPTables.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Inspector.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Lifecycle.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Lister.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Netem.go
  - pkg/container/mock_Stressor.go
  - pkg/runtime/containerd/mock_apiClient.go
  - pkg/runtime/docker/mock_conn.go
languages:
  go:
    enabled: true
  typescript:
    enabled: false
  python:
    enabled: false
analyzers:
  syntax:
    enabled: true
